subject: numeracy
nipun_lo: Grade 1 goal: reads and writes numbers up to 99 and does simple addition and subtraction; this episode covers taking away from a group of up to 9
notes: Subtraction means taking some away and counting how many are left. Use objects and fingers: 7 seeds, take away 2, 5 are left. Say it as a sentence: 6 take away 1 leaves 5. Taking away nothing leaves the same number; taking away all leaves nothing (zero). Count back by one to find one less. Introduce the - sign on the slate only after the idea is clear. Start numbers stay at 9 or below and answers are never negative.
